game.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (Nintendo Switch 2)
game.notes: Genesis Mode. The 2026 remake is a Switch 2 exclusive and Switch 2 has no system-level achievements, so no native list exists anywhere. Research caveat: Zelda Wiki and Nintendo's own pages were unreachable to every scout; facts come from guide and review sites (medium confidence). The player does not own the game yet and asked, at the checkpoint, to include only what research could confirm. Consequently the following were deliberately left out until they can be verified for the remake: the Biggoron's Sword trading sequence, Big Poe hunting, dedicated Fishing Pond and minigame trophies (fishing prize thresholds conflict between sources), the Gerudo training ground (name and reward unverified), Magic Beans and the mask quest. Collection trophies are anchored to in-game rewards (House of Skulltula gifts, the life meter, Quest Status song staff, bottle slots, Collection screen) (item-get messages, the life meter, the pause-menu songs page) rather than to per-region map counters or named menu screens, whose existence on the console is unconfirmed. Validator warnings on OOT-018/019/020/021 (cumulative without a named counter) are accepted: each is confirmed by a discrete in-game event — the HUD life meter showing 20 hearts, and the House of Skulltula handing over its 20-, 30- and 100-token rewards, which it only does once the threshold is reached — so the player never has to count manually. ZELDA NOTES (smartphone app) is never used as verification because it is not part of the game. Master Quest, Hero Mode, New Game+ and DLC do not exist in the remake at launch. amiibo-gated masks are excluded because they require extra hardware. Hall of Fallen Foes trials (Stone, Silver, Gold) are a remake addition; their exact unlock trigger conflicts across sources, so trophies describe the trial, not the unlock route. Revision after audit round 1: the Great Fairy trophy was dropped (count and menu conflict between sources: 3 vs 6 rewards), and the all-bottles trophy was dropped because one bottle requires the excluded Big Poe hunt. Side-content coverage is knowingly thin; this follows the player's checkpoint instruction to include only confirmed content. The list should be revised (listVersion 1.1) once the remake can be checked first-hand: Epona and Lon Lon Ranch, minigames, the Biggoron trade, Great Fairies, Big Poes and the Gerudo Fortress are the expected additions. Audit round 2 found that OOT-018 (20 hearts) and OOT-021 (100 tokens) depend on fishing, minigame and Magic Bean content excluded elsewhere; the player chose to keep both full collections and accept that dependency, so the Platinum does include that content indirectly. Status set to approved on that player decision after the second revision round, per the pipeline's two-round limit.

trophies.name: The Boy Without a Fairy
trophies.description: Leave Kokiri Forest and receive Saria's Fairy Ocarina on the bridge.
trophies.verification: The Fairy Ocarina appears on the item screen after the farewell scene on the Kokiri Forest bridge.

trophies.name: Queen of the Deku Tree
trophies.description: Defeat Gohma inside the Great Deku Tree.
trophies.verification: Gohma drops a Heart Container and the Kokiri's Emerald is received in the cutscene that follows.

trophies.name: Bomb Flower Feast
trophies.description: Defeat King Dodongo in Dodongo's Cavern.
trophies.verification: King Dodongo drops a Heart Container and the Goron's Ruby is received in the cutscene that follows.

trophies.name: Inside the Guardian
trophies.description: Defeat Barinade in the belly of Lord Jabu-Jabu.
trophies.verification: Barinade drops a Heart Container and the Zora's Sapphire is received in the cutscene that follows.

trophies.name: The Blade of Evil's Bane
trophies.description: Draw the Master Sword from the Pedestal of Time.
trophies.verification: The Temple of Time cutscene plays as Link draws the Master Sword from the pedestal.

trophies.name: Phantom of the Forest
trophies.description: Defeat Phantom Ganon in the Forest Temple.
trophies.verification: Phantom Ganon drops a Heart Container and the Forest Medallion is received in the cutscene that follows.

trophies.name: Dragonslayer
trophies.description: Defeat Volvagia in the Fire Temple.
trophies.verification: Volvagia drops a Heart Container and the Fire Medallion is received in the cutscene that follows.

trophies.name: Cold Waters of Truth
trophies.description: Reach the end of the Ice Cavern and claim the treasure hidden in its depths.
trophies.verification: Link reaches the final chest of the Ice Cavern and the item-get message for its treasure plays (reported: the Iron Boots, followed by Sheik teaching the Serenade of Water).
trophies.notes: Iron Boots and Serenade of Water reward per guide sources; unconfirmed against first-party material.

trophies.name: Your Own Shadow
trophies.description: Defeat the dark reflection waiting in the Water Temple.
trophies.verification: Dark Link vanishes, the misty room clears and the door to the Longshot chest opens.

trophies.name: The Temple Everyone Remembers
trophies.description: Defeat Morpha in the Water Temple.
trophies.verification: Morpha drops a Heart Container and the Water Medallion is received in the cutscene that follows.

trophies.name: The Eye of Truth
trophies.description: Explore the Bottom of the Well and obtain the Lens of Truth.
trophies.verification: The item-get message for the Lens of Truth plays and the item becomes available in the pause menu.

trophies.name: Drums in the Dark
trophies.description: Defeat Bongo Bongo in the Shadow Temple.
trophies.verification: Bongo Bongo drops a Heart Container and the Shadow Medallion is received in the cutscene that follows.

trophies.name: Sorceress Sisters
trophies.description: Defeat Twinrova in the Spirit Temple.
trophies.verification: Twinrova drops a Heart Container and the Spirit Medallion is received in the cutscene that follows.

trophies.name: The King of Evil
trophies.description: Defeat Ganondorf atop his castle.
trophies.verification: The tower collapse sequence begins after the Ganondorf fight ends.

trophies.name: Hero of Time
trophies.description: Defeat Ganon and see the ending.
trophies.verification: The ending cutscene and credits play.

trophies.name: Maestro of Time
trophies.description: Learn every song.
trophies.verification: The cutscene for the last song Link can learn plays and every song is shown in the pause menu's song display.
trophies.notes: Reported 12 songs for the remake (original-based count, unverified first-hand); Scarecrow's Song, if present, is not required.

trophies.name: Four Make One
trophies.description: Collect four Pieces of Heart to form a new heart.
trophies.verification: The life meter gains a new heart when the fourth piece is collected.

trophies.name: Heart of a Legend
trophies.description: Raise the life meter to its maximum of 20 hearts.
trophies.verification: The life meter on the HUD shows 20 hearts.
trophies.notes: 20 hearts = 3 starting + 8 boss Heart Containers + 36 Pieces of Heart (36 stated by two guide sites, not first-party). Requires every Piece of Heart, which in the original includes pieces from the Fishing Pond, minigames and Magic Bean spots; kept by explicit player decision. No confirmed console-side tracker for the last pieces; the optional ZELDA NOTES map can help but is not the verification.

trophies.name: It Hums Near Spiders
trophies.description: Reach 20 Gold Skulltula Tokens and claim the Echo Gem at the House of Skulltula.
trophies.verification: The item-get message for the Echo Gem plays when the House of Skulltula hands over its 20-token reward.

trophies.name: Deep Pockets
trophies.description: Reach 30 Gold Skulltula Tokens and claim the Giant's Wallet at the House of Skulltula.
trophies.verification: The item-get message for the Giant's Wallet plays when the House of Skulltula hands over its 30-token reward.

trophies.name: The Curse Is Lifted
trophies.description: Collect all 100 Gold Skulltula Tokens and claim the final reward at the House of Skulltula.
trophies.verification: The House of Skulltula hands over its 100-token reward (reported as a Gold Rupee).
trophies.notes: Requires every token, which in the original includes Magic Bean, age-gated and night-only tokens; kept by explicit player decision. Missable status is unverified for the remake (none reported missable by KeenGamer). No confirmed console-side total; the optional ZELDA NOTES map can help but is not the verification.

trophies.name: Where Foes Rest
trophies.description: Enter the Hall of Fallen Foes by sleeping in a glowing green bed.
trophies.verification: Link arrives in the Hall of Fallen Foes, with statues of defeated enemies on display.

trophies.name: Trial of Stone
trophies.description: Clear the Stone Statue trial in the Hall of Fallen Foes.
trophies.verification: The last boss of the Stone Statue gauntlet is defeated without leaving the trial and the trial is marked cleared in the Hall of Fallen Foes.
trophies.notes: A trophy on the shelf of Link's house is reported as the reward (KeenGamer, RPG Site, FinalBoss); Shacknews reports a Gold Rupee instead. Treated as supporting detail only. Some coverage calls the area the Hall of Fallen Heroes.

trophies.name: Trial of Silver
trophies.description: Clear the Silver Statue trial in the Hall of Fallen Foes.
trophies.verification: The last boss of the Silver Statue gauntlet is defeated without leaving the trial and the trial is marked cleared in the Hall of Fallen Foes.
trophies.notes: A trophy on the shelf of Link's house is reported as the reward (KeenGamer, RPG Site, FinalBoss); Shacknews reports a Gold Rupee instead. Treated as supporting detail only. Some coverage calls the area the Hall of Fallen Heroes.

trophies.name: Trial of Gold
trophies.description: Clear the Gold Statue trial in the Hall of Fallen Foes.
trophies.verification: The last boss of the Gold Statue gauntlet is defeated without leaving the trial and the trial is marked cleared in the Hall of Fallen Foes.
trophies.notes: Reportedly requires finishing the story and includes Ganondorf and Ganon. Bedroom-shelf reward per RPG Site and FinalBoss; Shacknews reports a Gold Rupee instead. A trophy on the shelf of Link's house is reported as the reward (KeenGamer, RPG Site, FinalBoss); Shacknews reports a Gold Rupee instead. Treated as supporting detail only. Some coverage calls the area the Hall of Fallen Heroes.

trophies.name: The Ballad of the Hero of Time
trophies.description: Earn every other trophy.
trophies.verification: Every other trophy in this list is earned.
